QUOTE: `retryFailedPost` in `post.ts:228` runs when the user taps the failed post (its caller is `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says there are zero automatic retries and that `retryFailedPost` runs only on user action on the failed post, which is the item's substance. It does not use the "Try Again" label.
